{{Quote|Don't worry about him, let him go!|CT-0000/1010, Fox, ordering his men to cease firing at [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
'''Fox''', also known by the number '''CT-0000/1010''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], Fox was assigned to the renowned [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] where he served as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. For nearly the entirety of his career, Sergeant Fox was stationed on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] or its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]]. Fox often worked in tandem with [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|planetary security]] while stationed on Coruscant, arranging patrols of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]' [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] in an effort to root out possible [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] threats. During this time, Fox became acquainted with the [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protectors]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]], and his fascination with the group of [[Constable/Legends|constables]] led to a desire to join them following the war's end.

In the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the Clone Wars, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] enemies of the Republic, and assembled the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] to [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|assault]] their Coruscant [[Jedi Temple/Legends|temple]]. Fox and his 501st compatriots marched on the Jedi Temple, enacting a massacre that left an untold number of Jedi dead and the Temple aflame. When the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senator]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], arrived to investigate the chaotic scheme, Fox and a unit of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] rebuffed the [[Senator/Legends|senator's]] efforts to enter the burning Temple. As Organa made to leave, the clones came under attack by Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]], attempting to flee the Temple via the landing platform. Though Jukassa managed to wound Fox's [[Clone Commander/Legends|senior officer]], [[Appo/Legends|CC-1119]]—Commander Appo—the sergeant shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Padawan. Fox also ordered the 501st to allow Senator Organa to depart unharmed, having grown tired of battle and all the killing.

==Biography==
===Soldier of the Republic===
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], CT-0000/1010 was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Kamino to serve in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="Troopers" /> Assigned to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and entrusted the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], CT-0000/1010 took the name of "Fox" as his own.<ref name="GttGAR" /> As the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] between the Republic and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],<ref name="AotC" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> saw the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] deployed throughout the galaxy. But while the 501st Legion saw combat on numerous worlds over the course of the war,<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Fox spent nearly the entirety of his military career stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]—the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Republic—or its [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]].<ref name="GttGAR" />

[[File:501st-ROTS.png|thumb|left|300px|Fox and the 501st on Coruscant]]
While assigned to the galactic capital, Sergeant Fox frequently worked with [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Forces]], and helped to establish patrols in the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]' [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] in order to guard against potential [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] activity. His [[Time/Legends|time]] spent among the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] community and the civilian population of Coruscant—both Human and [[Alien/Legends|non-human]] alike—exposed Fox to a look at life as it existed outside of the Grand Army. At some point during the war, Fox became aware of the [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protectors]],<ref name="GttGAR" /> a group of respected [[Constable/Legends|constables]] from his [[Clone template/Legends|progenitor]] Jango Fett's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Concord Dawn]],<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> and developed a lasting fascination with the group. As the Clone Wars wore on, Fox longed for an end to the conflict and the completion of his service to the Republic military, aspiring to join the ranks of the Journeyman Protectors once discharged to civilian life.<ref name="GttGAR" />

===Operation: Knightfall===
{{Quote|Get him!|CC-1119, commanding Fox and his troops to attack [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEC" /> the various detachments of the 501st Legion scattered across the galaxy's many theaters of war were discretely transferred back to Coruscant.<ref name="Battlefront" /> Shortly thereafter, the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the clones troopers of the Grand Army: the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency order]] asserted that the army's [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi officers]] had been found acting against the Republic, and commanded their removal by [[Death/Legends|lethal force]]. While [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] throughout the galaxy were cut down by their troops for supposed acts of [[Treason/Legends|treason]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Sergeant Fox and the 501st Legion followed the newly anointed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in a march on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the Coruscant headquarters of a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that Chancellor Palpatine had now declared an enemy of the Republic.<ref name="RotS" /> Fox and the other troopers of the 501st dispersed throughout the Temple on the orders of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|CC-1119]]—"Appo"<ref name="DarkLord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>—killing both Jedi and the [[Temple Security Force]]s that attempted to defend them.<ref name="Battlefront" />

[[File:Zett_Jukasa_Order_66.png|thumb|right|300px|Fox and the 501st engage Zett Jukassa]]
In the waning [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of the Temple massacre, Fox and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of other clone troopers were present as Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] landed his [[XJ-2 airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] at one of the tower [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] in an effort to investigate the burning Jedi Temple. Sergeant Fox and Commander Appo turned Organa away, informing the senator of the Jedi rebellion, but came under sudden attack by Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]] as the boy attempted to flee the Temple by way of the landing platform.<ref name="RotS" /> Jukassa managed to kill several troopers and wounded Appo with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] before Fox finally shot and killed the Padawan.<ref name="DAJ" /> Organa shouted and fled at the sight of the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling's]] death, while Fox ordered that the senator be let go;<ref name="RotS" /> the sergeant believed there had been enough killing that night,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and had lost his [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] for battle after it all.<ref name="GttGAR" />

In the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to come, Fox's desire for an end to the Clone Wars<ref name="GttGAR" /> was at last realized, and the victorious Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine the newly crowned [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="RotS" /> Sergeant Fox's actions during the Temple skirmish with Jukassa were detailed in an after action report written by Commander Appo and [[Casualty Report: Order 66|compiled]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Marcellin Wessel]] for presentation to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.<ref name="DAJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Stationed on Coruscant during the course of the Clone Wars, Fox's exposure to the civilian populace of the galactic capital gave him a look at life outside the military. As a result, the sergeant developed a longing for the war's end and a chance at a civilian life of his own. Fox looked forward to a day after the war when he could join the Journeyman Protectors of Concord Dawn, fascinated by the world's<ref name="GttGAR" /> respected constables.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Though he loyally served the Republic through the completion<ref name="RotS" /> of Operation: Knightfall,<ref name="Battlefront" /> the Jedi massacre left Fox with no stomach for further battle,<ref name="GttGAR" /> having grown tired of all the killing.<ref name="TCSWE" />

As a clone of Jango Fett, Fox stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and possessed [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin.<ref name="Troopers" /> He spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], and was proficient with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Equipment==
During the later years of the Clone Wars, Sergeant Fox wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]<ref name="RotS" /> bearing the distinctive blue markings of the 501st Legion.<ref name="Battlefront" /> While stationed on Coruscant during the final days of the Republic, Fox carried a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Fox was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[2006]], albeit unnamed, in the third entry of the ''Star Wars'' [[Prequel trilogy|prequel film trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']], together with the film's accompanying [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Matthew Stover]], and [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|adaptation]]. As with all clone troopers appearing in ''Revenge of the Sith'', Fox's voice was provided by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Temuera Morrison]]. Fox later received a brief character entry in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-forth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''{{'s}} article "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman]], wherein he was given the numerical clone designation CT-0000/1010.
